description: Source code for a Kivy-based touch tracing demonstration app, including touch event handling, drawing, and pressure normalization.

classes.name: Touchtracer
classes.description: Main widget handling touch events and drawing.

classes.name: TouchtracerApp
classes.description: Application class for the touch tracer demo.

methods.name: calculate_points
methods.description: Calculates intermediate points between two coordinates for smooth drawing.

methods.name: Touchtracer.normalize_pressure
methods.description: Normalizes pressure input to a suitable point size.

methods.name: Touchtracer.on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch start events, initializes drawing and labels.

methods.name: Touchtracer.on_touch_move
methods.description: Handles touch move events, updates drawing trails and pressure-based point sizes.

methods.name: Touchtracer.on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch end events, cleans up drawing and labels.

methods.name: Touchtracer.update_touch_label
methods.description: Updates the label with current touch information.
